facts.statement: Thread titles 'Obama Promotion Day #2', '#3' and '#4' were posted in the forum between 2009-01-21 and 2009-01-24. The page does not say what the promotion was.

article_summaries.title: vbPlaza Shop Releases - Free Realms Forums
article_summaries.summary: This is a thread index of the fan forum section 'vbPlaza Shop Releases' under Snowhills News Tower on freerealmsforums.com, captured 2009-05-26. It lists thread titles only, with no thread bodies, so it gives a rebuilder almost no game mechanics. The titles mention vbPlaza gift and collectible releases, an Easter Egg series, a Hershey Kiss gift set, and Obama Promotion Days, but the page does not explain what any of these were in-game.
